task.title: Migrate system architecture diagram to canonical YAML
task.summary: Move the architecture diagram contract into `.codewiki/kb/system/diagrams/architecture.yaml`, define YAML-as-canonical rendering semantics, and mark `architecture.mmd` as compatibility/export only or remove it with validation evidence.

goal.outcome: Architecture diagram truth lives under `system/diagrams` as agent-editable YAML with stable IDs and renderer hints for future Pi TUI ASCII rendering.
acceptance: `.codewiki/kb/system/diagrams/architecture.yaml` exists with schema_version, id, title, kind, purpose, source_docs, renderer hints, nodes/groups/edges, and stable local IDs.
`.codewiki/kb/system/diagrams/README.md` states YAML is canonical, Mermaid is export/compatibility only, and HTML/SVG/generated ASCII are not source truth.
`architecture.mmd` is either removed after migration or explicitly marked compatibility/export only with no conflicting canonical status.
Diagram refs and stale-reference audits pass for changed docs.
non_goals: Do not implement the TUI renderer in this task.
Do not rewrite all existing diagrams unless needed for the architecture migration.
Do not make Mermaid, HTML, SVG, or generated ASCII canonical.
verification: graph lint count for target diagram refs has no new errors
manual review that architecture.yaml preserves architecture.mmd nodes/edges
